open_points.subject: A17 secure path walk: final component
open_points.text: “each directory on the way opened with `O_PATH` and `O_DIRECTORY` … and the last component for reading”
open_points.question: With which flags is the last component opened, particularly whether `O_NONBLOCK` is used so a FIFO or device cannot block or cause effects before the regular-file check?
options: Open with `O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW` and permit the open itself to block
Open with `O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK`, then check that the opened object is a regular file
Inspect using a non-reading descriptor first, then obtain a reading descriptor while preserving the same-file guarantee
open_points.default_guess: Open the last component with `O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK`, check it through that descriptor, and reject anything other than a regular file.

open_points.subject: A17 secure path walk: path with no non-empty component
open_points.text: “every component the path names, `.` and `..` included, opened as named, and an empty one, from a repeated or trailing `/`, skipped”
open_points.question: What does the walk do when skipping empty components leaves no last component, as for `/`, `//`, or an empty relative path?
options: Treat the starting root or working directory as the target and reject it at the regular-file check
Refuse immediately because there is no final file component
Treat an empty relative path differently from an absolute path containing only slashes
open_points.default_guess: Refuse immediately as a file that cannot be read because no final file component exists.

open_points.subject: A17 secure path walk: relative configuration path
open_points.text: “a relative one from the working directory”
open_points.question: For later configuration re-reads, is a relative configuration path resolved from the working directory captured at startup, or from the process working directory at each re-open?
options: Capture and retain the startup working-directory descriptor as the path-walk anchor
Resolve from the process working directory anew on every read
Resolve the relative argument to an absolute path once at startup and walk that path thereafter
open_points.default_guess: Capture the startup working-directory descriptor and use it for every later re-open.
